_comment: Pinned upstream coordinates for Ghidra. BARE does not vendor, fork, or
modify Ghidra: the image downloads this exact release archive from the
National Security Agency's own GitHub releases and verifies it against the
This file is the single source of truth. sandbox/images/ghidra/Dockerfile
declares the same values as ARG defaults and tests/unit/test_ghidra_pin.py
asserts the two agree, so a bump cannot land in one and not the other.
To bump: run `uv run python scripts/fetch_ghidra.py --check-upstream`,
which reports the latest release and its published digest, then update
both this file and the Dockerfile and re-run the test.
